create-table-references: The new empty source table references existing matter, record and entity keys. Creating its foreign keys locks the parents but scans no existing source rows; lock_timeout is 1s and statement_timeout is 5s.
create-policy: The workspace and review-reset policies are catalog-only additions to the source table created earlier in this migration, which holds no rows yet; lock_timeout is 1s and statement_timeout is 5s.
row-level-security: ENABLE and FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY apply to the newly created empty source table. Both are catalog changes without a data rewrite, under 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
create-trigger: The source deletion trigger is attached to the newly created empty source table through a catalog change; this migration executes no application DML or history backfill. Lock acquisition is bounded by 1s lock_timeout and each statement by 5s statement_timeout.
